permitFee.note: North Carolina charges no fee to apply for a sales and use tax certificate of registration.

penalty.note: 5% of the tax for each month or part of a month the return is late, up to 25%; a 5% failure-to-pay penalty also applies.

unemployment.note: 5% of the contributions due for each month or fraction a report is late, up to 25% or $5, whichever is greater.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: Administrative penalty of $20 to $100 per day of noncompliance (N.C.G.S. 97-94).
